errors.problem: Recommendation overreaches its evidence and cuts against the document's own reasoning. The one episode that supplies 88% of the 'exiting coloured' evidence (south/202, unit 2509, fire d 1-3 on 81 of 85 exiting steps) ends in that unit dying in fire at step 177. Under the proposed rule the table would have shown NO colour cue for the 81 steps preceding that death. 5.3(b) itself calls exiting 'the most dangerous leg' with 'no protection', and 4.3 notes death is radius 0 and an exiting unit never retreats - i.e. fire proximity is MORE operationally relevant while exiting, not less. The doc never weighs this cost. The accounting also omits the DEAD state: 90 of 134 dead unit-steps (67.2%) are coloured at d<=3 although no range applies either, and the proposed rule does not say what a dead (or stale-position off-grid, B.2) row should show.

That the literals 1 and 3 coincide with the two ranges is an inference (supported only by the builder comment at dashboard_state_builder.py:300-305 mentioning '3 idle / 1 assigned'). All 43 victim-diamond-hidden steps are victim 2503 in east/101.

Citations confirmed at HEAD: serve_dashboard.py:895 (red <=1 / amber <=3, state-blind), :890-895 comment text, :103-104 whitelist (assigned present, exiting absent), :168-175, :856 setLineDash([5,4]), :806-812 and :828-847, :545 (border 1px + radius 10px -> 9 px inner curve; 81*(1-pi/4) = 17.38; 4.5^2+5.5^2 = 50.5), :577 speed default 200; dashboard_state_builder.py:341 'exiting'; common_fixed_variables.py:130-134; wildfire_model.py:640-645; class Firefighter = agents.py:1489-2834 with zero matches for base_station|depot|berth; fovframe_part1.txt 85.0-88.3% overlap, 31.2-39.6% clipping, 16.1%, docked-UAV rule. '0 disagreements in 4,338' holds over the FULL 4,338 (assigned attr == target_pos truthiness in every state, including exiting where both are True) even though _bm_trace_analyze.py:94 only tests it on idle/assigned rows.

'CLIPPING HAS MORE THAN DOUBLED' holds seed-matched (seed 101: 31.2-31.7% -> 74.7-100.0%; seed 202: 39.6% -> 81.7-96.3%) but not range-min vs range-max (74.7/39.6 = 1.89); FOV-round params also differed (1 FT + 2 VS, 4 victims, 2 firefighters, wind east) - worth one clause.

'assigned->idle (recall) 5' and 'every one is a real event': the label cannot be verified from the traces. In all five cases the target victim is still present on its target cell at the transition; west/101 steps 232 and 233 have two units (2508, 2509) dropping the same target (32,0) on consecutive steps, 2509 while still standing at (4,44) next to the depot. 'Recall' is an uninspected label.

The 'fire d' measurements use the trace's nearest_fire (a.is_burning(), a.pos) as a proxy for the panel's nearest_fire_dist (agent.burning via the unit's _min_fire_distance, 999 -> None). They are very likely equal but the traces do not record the panel value, so equality on these runs is not demonstrated.

stroke_px() extends every segment by 1.5 px at both ends (square-cap behaviour); canvas strokes of separate moveTo/lineTo segments use butt caps, so the diamond ink figures (358 px median, 135 px max hidden) are slight over-estimates at staircase corners. Dwell means exclude right-censored final runs, so they understate dwell (conservative).

Found in passing, candidate for Appendix B.4: the SHIPPED comment at serve_dashboard.py:804-805 still says a block 'is clipped on 31-40% of steps in a real run' - the mode-0 figure this document supersedes (74.7-100.0% at the shipped mode 3).

Judgement on 5.4: option (d) 'draw nothing' is adequately supported by verified evidence (three-state range incl. 'none', step-level 64.3% base clutter and step-0 lattice, identity with the victim diamond, low bind rate). The add-on (d+) is weaker than presented: it rests on an interpretive 'misstatement', on pooled rates dominated by one run each, and its 'uncolour while exiting' rule would have removed the only table cue before the single exiting death in the data. Hard rules observed: nothing under outputs/_firemech_rewound_20260914/ or .claude/worktrees was read or listed; no model, simulation, pytest or state-changing git command was run; no tracked file or basemark_part1.txt was modified (scratch scripts only in the session scratchpad).
